subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers land the linked fork cleanup PR, replace it with a same-repo cleanup PR, or close that candidate and leave this issue open for later sequencing?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and narrow, but an open fork PR already owns the proposed fix path and is not a merged same-repo fix that ClawSweeper can treat as implemented.

options.title: Review or replace the linked cleanup PR
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate and either land it after proof/refresh or replace it with an equivalent maintainer-owned branch.

options.title: Close the candidate, keep this issue
options.body: If the fork branch is not usable, close that candidate while preserving this issue as the canonical source-reproducible bug.

options.title: Defer placeholder cleanup
options.body: Leave this issue open without active implementation if maintainers want to sequence it behind broader Google Chat delivery lifecycle work.

recommendation.title: Review or replace the linked cleanup PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as the current candidate and either land it after proof/refresh or replace it with an equivalent maintainer-owned branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history in the Google Chat reply-delivery extraction and placeholder lifecycle code where the cleanup belongs.
